event.event_name: IPL Match: Gujarat Titans vs Mumbai Indians

actions.action: Conduct matchday shift briefing and verify radio channels with GRP & security marshals.
actions.reason: Ensure unified crowd control protocol and emergency response readiness across all zones.
actions.trigger: Time: 60 minutes before scheduled event conclusion.

actions.action: Power on and pre-position 4 standby 3-car rakes at Sabarmati & Motera sidings.
actions.reason: Enables zero-headway shuttle dispatch immediately when stadium egress begins.

actions.action: Reverse 4 exit gates to dedicated entry mode (14 total entry gates active) and test QR scanners.
actions.reason: Maximises ingress capacity to 455 pax/min to absorb initial pre-match departure rush.
actions.trigger: Time: 20 minutes prior to final whistle.

actions.action: Deploy barricade pens on footbridge and station forecourt plaza with directional signage.
actions.reason: Organises incoming stadium flow into manageable queues before entering concourse.

actions.action: Implement 3-minute mainline headway on North-South corridor and notify all station controllers.
actions.reason: Event has concluded; primary mass departure wavefront entering transit corridor.
actions.trigger: Event end notification received from stadium control.

actions.action: Throttle concourse turnstile entry by 85%; hold passengers in concourse and forecourt pens.
actions.reason: Platform density approaching 2.0 pax/m² hold threshold; prevents dangerous platform overcrowding.

actions.action: Dock empty shuttle Rake #1 on Platform Up (Southbound); extend dwell to 60 seconds.
actions.reason: Absorbs 382 standing/seated passengers with zero upstream arrival load.
actions.trigger: Time: T+14 scheduled peak shuttle insertion.

actions.action: Release 500 passengers from forecourt pen to concourse gates following train departure.
actions.reason: Platform density dropped below 1.5 pax/m² hysteresis recovery threshold.

actions.action: Dispatch shuttle Rake #2 toward Gandhinagar on Platform Down; announce quick boarding.
actions.reason: Relieves build-up for northern IT/institutional passengers heading to GNLU/Infocity.
actions.trigger: Time: T+30 scheduled peak shuttle insertion.

actions.action: Transition corridor headway from 3 minutes to 4 minutes; return standby rakes to siding.
actions.reason: Primary stadium surge cleared (78% of riders transported); rate of new arrivals tapering.

actions.action: Restore the 4 reversed entry turnstiles to regular exit orientation; dismantle outdoor pens.
actions.reason: Station foot traffic transitioning back to standard post-midnight volume.
actions.trigger: Condition: Forecourt queue cleared to zero.

actions.action: Confirm 100% platform clearance, execute station security sweep, and log shift report with OCC.
actions.reason: All matchday attendees safely transported; normal overnight maintenance block commences.
actions.trigger: Condition: Last passenger boarded; all platform queues cleared.

assumptions: Usable platform fraction calibrated at 0.60 (stairs/buffers subtracted).
Max comfort load factor capped at 0.85 (crush loads never scheduled).
AFC entry gates: 10 base + 4 reversed in AI plan; 1.3x QR scan multiplier.
Pass-through trains carry 25% background arrival load at night.
Originating shuttle trains carry 0% arrival load, turning back at STN_12/STN_23.
Hold threshold: Fruin LOS E (2.0 pax/m²); resume hysteresis at 1.5 pax/m².

constraint_checks.name: Fleet limit check
constraint_checks.detail: 28 rakes required vs 26 maximum available fleet.

constraint_checks.name: Signalling headway safety floor
constraint_checks.detail: Minimum headway 3 min >= 3 min practical safe floor (CBTC floor 90s).

constraint_checks.name: Platform safe holding threshold
constraint_checks.detail: Peak platform density 2.44 pax/m² (hold threshold 2.0 pax/m²).

constraint_checks.name: Human approval requirement
constraint_checks.detail: Plan flagged for Chief Train Controller (OCC) formal digital sign-off.

constraint_checks.name: Fixed rake length policy
constraint_checks.detail: Preserves permanently coupled 3-car sets (no dynamic rake decoupling).

constraint_checks.name: p90 surge robustness check
constraint_checks.detail: At +20% attendance (126,000), peak platform density remains safe at 2.47 pax/m².
